Information from the meeting of the Monetary Policy
The Council decided to keep the NBP interest rates unchanged:
The Council decided to keep the NBP interest rates unchanged:
Global economic conditions are showing further signs of improvement, particularly the United States, GDP growth declined in 2017 Q1, most probably due to temporary factors.

Economic growth is still driven primarily by increasing consumer demand, supported by rising employment and wages, good consumer sentiment and disbursement of benefits.

In the Council's opinion, in the following quarters inflation will remain moderate amid fading effects of the past increase in global commodity prices, with only a gradual rise in domestic inflationary pressure stemming from improving domestic economic conditions.
